svg.title: What’s inside Cosmos
svg.desc: Catalogue sizes and sources: 2.2 million galaxies, 109,389 stars, 75,855 asteroids, 35,652 satellites and debris, 6,451 exoplanets and more.
svg.text: Real catalogues, counted from public/data. Bar length is log scale (each tick is 10×); every record carries a source.
Gaia Catalogue of Nearby Stars, within 100 pc
NASA Exoplanet Archive PSCompPars (4,847 host stars)
NASA DONKI flares, CMEs, storms (2024-10 to 2026-10)
Radio to gamma rays (Planck, Gaia, 2MASS, WISE, ROSAT, Fermi)

Counts from public/data/manifest.json (generated 2026-10-20) and docs/data/*.md. Orbital counts follow the CelesTrak snapshot of 2026-10-17; the on-screen total of about 31,800 is the objects with orbit elements.
